about: RULING 2 (fix/htf-exchange-day): a resampler keys an intraday series' bar's week or month by the exchange's local (New York) session date, never its UTC date; both lanes keep every bar the series holds in a higher-timeframe aggregate, and the bars that show or read a week or month holding a session the exchange never held (a weekend, an NYSE full closure) are withheld by name (request:htf-closure-session). Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.
